verdict.rationale: llama.cpp documents its own 1.5- to 8-bit integer quantization, which covers INT4-style models in its native GGUF format, and community users confirm quantized models like Q6_K work well. Nothing in the evidence shows it can load GPTQ, AWQ, or FP8 checkpoints directly, so only part of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: evidence of GPTQ loading, AWQ loading, FP8 support, and documentation of loading non-GGUF quantized formats.
